# QLX

> Type-safe, schema-first PostgreSQL query builder for Go with zero reflection, static analysis, and native pgx v5.

## Self-Contained AI Specification

- [Full Autonomous AI Context](llms-full.txt): Complete, 100% self-contained reference and grammar rules for AI coding agents. Contains CLI/configuration (`qlx.yaml`), all `qt` types, PostgreSQL ENUMs, `qjson`/`qvalidator`, `qpage`, `pgxexec`, `otelqlx`, `qtest`, query patterns, mutation rules, all `qext/*` extension helpers, `qlxvet` analyzer rules, and anti-hallucination checklists.

## Reference & Project Documentation

- [Project README](README.md): Quick start, examples, row mapping, validation, and module overview.
- [SQL to Go Grammar Mapping](docs/sql-to-go.md): Complete correspondence table between PostgreSQL grammar and QLX functions.
- [Generated Function Reference](docs/pgcat/README.md): Full catalog reference for `pg` / `pgcat/*` built-in functions and operators.
- [Limits](docs/limits.md): What the compiler, analyzer, renderer, and server catch — and what they cannot.
- [Stability Guarantees](STABILITY.md): Semantic versioning promises, generated ABI, and frozen interfaces.
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md): Breaking changes and evolution towards and beyond 1.0.
